user.title: ebusd
user.description: ebusd started with --enablehex, reachable over TCP.

error.cannot_connect: ebusd does not answer, or does not accept hex commands (--enablehex).

init.title: Weishaupt
init.description: Writes go to the boiler regulators. Writes from the service tool address ff are refused while WCM-Diagnose may be connected, which is read from the ebusd telegram log.

set_time_program.name: Set a time program day
set_time_program.description: Writes the slots of one day (up to 3, quarters of an hour), unused slots are cleared.

set_clock.name: Set the clock
set_clock.description: Broadcasts Home Assistant's time to the regulators (fe 0700 telegram, which sets the f1 clock). Touches no heating setting.

align.name: Align to the minute
align.description: Wait for the top of the next minute for a clock accurate to about a second (send immediately if off).
